rows:
Cold acquisition (SK block) + single-SKU offer push (B block). CVR focus.
Women 25–45 NL, sugar-conscious, flavour-loyal. Cold to brand (SK), product-aware (B).

4 concepts × 3 hook variants × 2 formats = 24 exports.
BM concepts: 15 s · SKM concepts: 20 s.
Rough cut for review by 17.06.

Meta standard: 4:5 (1080×1350) and 9:16 (1080×1920).
No 1:1.
Other platforms only on request (then with platform + pixels).

Drive: NOVA > 02_Assets (product renders, logo, fonts, brand colours).
Reference ads: NOVA > 03_Ads > Winner (pacing + style anchor).

VO is produced from this document (female speaker, per-concept direction below).
Pronunciation: NOVA = „NOH-vah“.
Captions always on (sound-off first), burned-in, brand font.
MP4 (H.264) per concept in 1080×1350 + 1080×1920 · Drive: NOVA > 04_Delivery > 260620_Motion.

blocks.text: Bold = ends up on the creative. Everything else is direction/context. Use every text 1:1 – don't change a word, don't invent numbers. [Placeholder: …] = value missing. Don't fill it in yourself – send it back to ADMKRS.
Overview
B-Block – Motion Concepts
BM-01  ·  Sweet Without the Sugar  –  Crunch

rows: Sweet · without sugar. The everyday-moment angle: yogurt, coffee, smoothie – Crunch upgrades all of them with one scoop.
15 s motion graphic · static-frame cuts, kinetic typography, no live-action faces.
10% off first Crunch order. Code TRYNOVA.

Warm, confident female voice.
Late 30s tonality.
Slightly playful, never preachy.
Like recommending something to a friend.

Bright, modern, sparse.
Single repeating piano motif + soft bass kick.
No drops, no swells.

blocks.text: 3 Hooks  ·  for scroll-stop testing

rows:
“One scoop. Six calories.”
Visual 0–2 s: macro spoon of Crunch, calorie counter ticks down to 6.
“This yoghurt has no taste of guilt!” Visual 0–2 s: hand spooning Crunch over plain yogurt, slow motion, golden light.
“I stopped buying sweeteners the day I tried this.” Visual 0–2 s: sweetener jar slides out of frame, Crunch lands in its place.

blocks.text: VO-Script (Spine)  ·  one take – copy block for VO production (identical to the storyboard VO column)

[ Hook A / B / C – eine der drei oben ]
Here's the thing – my coffee, my smoothie, my morning yogurt…
…one scoop of Crunch, and honestly, they all just taste better.
And it's six calories a scoop – but as sweet as fifty grams of sugar.
No weird aftertaste, nothing to feel bad about afterwards.
So go on, give it a try – ten percent off right now with the code TRYNOVA.
Storyboard  ·  Time-coded

rows: Hand spooning Crunch over plain yogurt. Slow motion, golden light. Hook text burns on screen.
“[ Hook · pick A, B, or C ]”
Cut to iced coffee with Crunch stirring in. Brown swirl in cream.
“Here's the thing – my coffee, my smoothie, my morning yogurt…”
Smoothie pour, vibrant colour. Quick whip-pan to product hero.
“…one scoop of Crunch, and honestly, they all just taste better.”
Product on light surface. Numbers animate in clean type.
“And it's six calories a scoop – but as sweet as fifty grams of sugar.”
Wide shot – yogurt bowl, smoothie, coffee all in frame.
“No weird aftertaste, nothing to feel bad about afterwards.”
Product hero. Code animates in. CTA button visible. End-card: Logo + product + CODE TRYNOVA – SHOP NOW. Hold 1 second.
“So go on, give it a try – ten percent off right now with the code TRYNOVA.”

blocks.text: BM-02  ·  Eight Litres. Zero Sugar.  –  Hydra

rows: Volume math is the dopamine spike. One bottle = eight litres. Zero of everything else. Direct trade against the daily ice-tea habit.
15 s motion graphic · liquid motion graphics, splash transitions, kinetic typography.
10% off first Hydra order. Code TRYNOVA.

Bright, direct female voice.
Early 30s, crisper than the Crunch scripts.
Slightly more energetic, never shouty.
Like a smart friend ordering for you.

Light percussion, hi-hats, water-drop FX.
Single sustained synth pad.
110 BPM, never aggressive.

blocks.text: 3 Hooks  ·  for scroll-stop testing

rows:
“One little bottle. Eight litres of flavour. Zero sugar.”
Visual 0–2 s: tiny bottle next to a row of eight 1-litre carafes.
“This little bottle replaced an entire fridge full of ice tea.” Visual 0–2 s: fridge door opens – ice-tea shelf morphs into one small bottle.
“The bottle that quietly ended my soft-drink habit.” Visual 0–2 s: empty soft-drink cans tip over, Hydra bottle stays standing.

blocks.text: VO-Script (Spine)  ·  one take – copy block for VO production (identical to the storyboard VO column)

[ Hook A / B / C – eine der drei oben ]
You know that drink you reach for every day – just without the sugar, without the calories…
…and without that little ‘why am I still drinking this’ voice in the back of your head.
One bottle of Hydra makes eight litres – that's two weeks of flavour for what a single fizzy drink costs.
Same habit you already have, just completely different math.
Give it a go: ten percent off with the code TRYNOVA.
Storyboard  ·  Time-coded

rows: Glass of plain water on a counter. Hook text appears.
“[ Hook · pick A, B, or C ]”
Pour-in of Hydra concentrate – colour blooms instantly through the water.
“You know that drink you reach for every day – just without the sugar, without the calories…”
Three flavour glasses splash into frame, one per second.
“…and without that little ‘why am I still drinking this’ voice in the back of your head.”
Bottle hero. Animated math: 1 bottle → 8 LITRES with liquid morph.
“One bottle of Hydra makes eight litres – that's two weeks of flavour for what a single fizzy drink costs.”
Friends clinking glasses, fast cut. Warm casual moment.
“Same habit you already have, just completely different math.”
Bottle hero. Code animates in. CTA button. End-card: Bottle + CODE TRYNOVA – SHOP NOW. Hold 1 second.
“Give it a go: ten percent off with the code TRYNOVA.”

blocks.text: SK-Block – Motion Concepts
SKM-01  ·  Welcome to NOVA  –  Starter Box

rows: Three felt moments of permission. Each one a complete sentence. No question marks. Reveal the kit only after the audience has nodded three times.
20 s motion graphic · product-led cuts, kinetic typography, warm lighting throughout.
30% off first Starter Box. Code TRYNOVA.

Warm, intimate, slightly conspiratorial female voice.
Late 30s, reads like a friend leaning in.
No salesman lift on the offer line.

Soft piano melody, builds gently, releases on the kit reveal.
80 BPM.
Quiet whoosh on each product cut.

blocks.text: 3 Hooks  ·  for scroll-stop testing

rows:
“Imagine your morning yogurt tasting like dessert.”
Visual 0–2 s: spoon lifts dessert-like yogurt swirl, morning light.
“Everything you'd normally feel guilty about – only made to actually work for you.” Visual 0–2 s: ‚guilty' snack stack dissolves into the clean NOVA line-up.
“This is the box that quietly changed how I eat.” Visual 0–2 s: hands open the Starter Box lid, soft reveal glow.

blocks.text: VO-Script (Spine)  ·  one take – copy block for VO production (identical to the storyboard VO column)

[ Hook A / B / C – eine der drei oben ]
Imagine your daily iced coffee – but with nineteen grams of protein already in it…
…and the snack you actually love, just without the guilt that usually tags along.
That's the whole idea behind this one box.
It's the NOVA Starter Box – all the food you already eat, finally made to work for you.
And right now you get thirty percent off your first kit with the code TRYNOVA.
Storyboard  ·  Time-coded

Kit hero. 30% OFF badge animates in. CTA. Code prominent. End-card: Kit hero + 30% OFF + CODE TRYNOVA – SHOP NOW. Hold 2 seconds.
“And right now you get thirty percent off your first kit with the code TRYNOVA.”

blocks.text: SKM-02  ·  The Protein Gap  –  Starter Box

rows: Open with the gap. Not the problem – the gap. Neutral, specific, quantified. Kit fills it. Numbers do the convincing.
20 s motion graphic · counter-led animation, kinetic typography, mid-energy edit.
30% off first Starter Box. Code TRYNOVA.

Steady, intelligent, lightly playful female voice.
Mid 30s.
Reads facts with confidence, never lectures, never pitches.

Mid-tempo electronic, light rhythmic pulse.
Bass-led but soft, builds into the kit reveal.
Subtle ‘tick’ on each protein number.

blocks.text: 3 Hooks  ·  for scroll-stop testing

rows:
“Most women miss their daily protein target by 50 grams!”
Visual 0–2 s: protein counter rolls and stops 50 g short of the target.
“The difference between 'eating clean' and 'eating enough protein' is bigger than you think.” Visual 0–2 s: split frame – ‚eating clean' plate vs. protein numbers overlay.
“How much protein do you actually eat? Most women overestimate by forty percent.” Visual 0–2 s: question mark builds from floating gram-numbers.

blocks.text: VO-Script (Spine)  ·  one take – copy block for VO production (identical to the storyboard VO column)

[ Hook A / B / C – eine der drei oben ]
We've kind of all given up on it – and not because we aren't trying.
It's just that real food, real protein and real flavour almost never show up in the same package.
At least, they didn't… until now.
Nineteen grams of protein in your coffee, fourteen in your snack, forty-three in your topping – all of it food you'd eat anyway.
Start now and get thirty percent off your first kit with the code TRYNOVA.

“We've kind of all given up on it – and not because we aren't trying.”
Three product reveals: coffee, snack, sahne. Each protein number floats up with a tick sound.
“It's just that real food, real protein and real flavour almost never show up in the same package.”
Beat of silence on dark frame. Then: kit appears with a single line of light.
Top-down kit in warm lighting. Quick product cuts with their numbers.
“Nineteen grams of protein in your coffee, fourteen in your snack, forty-three in your topping – all of it food you'd eat anyway.”
Kit hero. 30% OFF badge animates in. CTA. End-card: Kit + 30% OFF + CODE TRYNOVA – SHOP NOW. Hold 2 seconds.
“Start now and get thirty percent off your first kit with the code TRYNOVA.”
